title: Generative AI Search Engines as Arbiters of Public Knowledge: An Audit of Bias and Authority

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the correlation between the sentiment polarity of user queries and the sentiment polarity of the generated responses using a fine-tuned transformer model, as well as comparing median response polarities across different topics.

Manually reviewing the web domains of cited sources in the generated responses to identify their country or region of origin and analyzing their distribution to detect over-representation of specific regions (e.g., U.S. and Western countries).

Classifying the cited source web domains into categories based on organization type (e.g., Business, News and Media, Government) and analyzing the prevalence of commercial business websites in the system outputs.
